page: OVHcloud t2-180 is a high-density GPU compute instance designed for accelerated workloads and data-intensive tasks. The host configuration pairs 60 dedicated x86_64 physical cores from Intel Xeon 6226R processors clocked at 2.9 GHz with 180 GB of system memory, providing a non-hyperthreaded 1:1 core-to-thread ratio and 3.0 GB of RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs delivering a combined 128 GB of VRAM. Bundled local high-speed storage totals 4050 GB on NVMe SSD media, alongside a baseline network connection of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations highlight the platform's focus on hardware-accelerated computation. In machine learning inference evaluations, the server achieves top-tier results in prompt processing and text generation for medium (7B) language models at 121.32 tokens per second, alongside top-tier prompt ingestion for small (135M) models. General system performance ranks in the middle tier, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 10599.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 42227.9, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches top-quartile performance at 310.34 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the architecture centers on its specialized GPU configuration. While the four V100S accelerators and large 4050 GB local NVMe pool provide solid resource density without requiring external block storage, per-core CPU performance and host system memory bandwidth remain typical for middle-tier Cascade Lake Xeon systems. Additionally, the instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default, necessitating network configuration considerations for public ingress.

OVHcloud t2-180 is engineered specifically for deep learning model inference, distributed GPU training batches, high-throughput parallel decompression pipelines, and data science workflows requiring fast local NVMe staging coupled with multi-GPU parallel acceleration.
description: OVHcloud t2-180 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance featuring 60 dedicated Intel Xeon 6226R physical cores at 2.9 GHz, 180 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA Volta V100S graphics processing units delivering 128 GB of total VRAM. The system incorporates 4050 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and 10 Gbps baseline networking. In benchmark assessments, the t2-180 achieves top-tier throughput in language model inference across 135M and 7B parameter models, complemented by strong multi-threaded decompression results. The underlying CPU and memory subsystems exhibit average performance across general-purpose synthetic metrics. With its dense multi-GPU configuration, dedicated physical core allocation, and large local NVMe storage volume, the t2-180 is targeted at machine learning inference, distributed neural network acceleration, and data processing workflows requiring high GPU throughput.
